directions_tried.note: Inference-time style signal amplification on attention output. DINO-S dropped from 0.4614 (ll05) to 0.4479. Both input-side extrap (s1_extrap02=0.4338) and output-side amplification (s4_amp20=0.4479) harmful. Trained gate value is optimal — DINO-S sensitive to style signal strength.

directions_tried.description: WCT covariance interpolation beta=0.7 (30% content + 70% style covariance)
directions_tried.note: Mixing content covariance into style target dilutes style signal. Critical: both amplifying (S4=-0.0135) and diluting (S5=-0.0136) style signal hurt DINO-S equally. Trained WCT at beta=1.0 is local optimum.

directions_tried.description: WCT covariance interpolation beta=0.5 (50% content + 50% style covariance)
directions_tried.note: Identical DINO-S to beta=0.7 (0.4478). All perturbation directions converge to ~0.4478 floor. DINO-S=0.5 NOT achievable through inference-time statistical manipulation.

directions_tried.description: Adaptive Style Gate (ASG): gate_map = tanh(style_gate + MLP(content_features)), zero-init MLP, 5 epochs, batch=24
directions_tried.note: FIRST training-side direction. DINO-S=0.4843 is the HIGHEST EVER, breaking the 0.4617 inference-time ceiling by +0.0229. ASG makes style gate content-dependent (spatial gate map [B,1,H,W]). Flat areas get less style (protect content), textured areas get more style (enhance style). DINO-C=0.7692 (+0.0741 vs S0), LPIPS=0.3354 (-0.1277, much better content). CLIP-S=0.7261 (-0.0037, neutral). Zero-init MLP ensures safe training start. Gap to 0.5 target: 0.0157. Train: 23s/epoch, VRAM: 2.91GB.

directions_tried.description: Frequency-aware ASG: per-subband gates for LH/HL/HH before iDWT, zero-init MLPs, 5 epochs, batch=24
directions_tried.note: Phase T2: Per-subband gate differentiation. DINO-S=0.4833, micro-drop -0.001 vs T1 ASG. Per-subband gate is NOT the bottleneck — unified scalar gate + spatial self-adaptation already captures the main gain. Train: 22.6s/epoch, 904,300 params (+1K vs T1). VRAM: 2.96GB.

directions_tried.description: Adaptive WCT scales on T1 ASG checkpoint: per_subband_wct with content/style energy ratio adjusting per-subband WCT scales (inference-only)
directions_tried.note: Phase T4: Adaptive WCT scales (inference-only, no retraining). DINO-S=0.4801 (-0.004 vs T1 ASG). DINO-C=0.6123 (-0.157 SEVERE content destruction). LPIPS=0.5341 (+0.199 SEVERE content loss). Root cause: full-covariance WCT on ALL subbands including LL destroys content structure. Adaptive ratio (0.5-2.0) insufficient to mitigate WCT aggressiveness. Conclusion: full-covariance WCT on content-carrying subbands fundamentally harmful.

pivot_reason: Both adaptive directions (T2 FASG, T4 Adaptive WCT) failed. T1 ASG (DINO-S=0.4843) confirmed as local optimum. stale_count=2. Next: train ASG 10ep, tune MLP capacity, explore D1-Plus Gram loss.
